info.name: ParcelPath API
info.description:
Courier and logistics management REST API.

Roles: CUSTOMER, COURIER, ADMIN. Log in with each role first; the login requests store tokens in collection variables automatically.

All responses follow `{ success, message, data }` on success and `{ success, message, errors }` on failure.

request.description: Send a Google ID token obtained from Google Identity Services (or the OAuth Playground with your own client).
